body:
DISPOSITION: no turnover and no re-mint. At 21:3x the Observer read Ops working (36 commands in 300 s, context 87%). The real fault was a dropped grant. B asked for the U3 Group B v10 grant at 18:28:01, five minutes before Ops restarted in place, and filed the request with asks none, so Ops' view listed it as asking nothing. The review seat caught it at 21:29. Ops issued the grant at 21:32:25, valid unstarted until 21:47:25, and named its drop: three hours lost on the critical path. I am watching for B to start it.
Still open with Ops: the Hy-Bor letter's place, owed to the Desk since 18:27 (ord-co27-ops-hybor-letter-staged-unsent-1018). The Desk restart (ord-co27-ops-restart-desks-sweep-831-1018) rightly waits on the Desk's verified idle.
Sciences: a builder's grant request must carry asks reply, so that it cannot read as owed by no one.
